description: Pointing-jitter sensitivity of the event-stream model (handoff 2026-11-11 item 3.5). Model predictions for the recorded configurations; jitter amplitude and correlation time are assumptions.

conventions.jitter_model: first-order Gauss-Markov per image axis, seed 11, same path scaled by the rms
conventions.active_pixels: run-mean background below the lit limit (trigger-active)
conventions.energy_errors: complete (uncensored) records of detected flashes; ln(E_est/E_true)
